integrity: The mathematical statements and exact-reproducibility script are supplied in full. Earlier special cases and generic convex optimization principles are acknowledged. No priority or independent certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to simple internally vertex-disjoint source-to-sink directed-path unions in the unweighted ambient Euclidean incidence metric; no claim for arbitrary directed graphs, orientations, or weighted metrics. Finite enumerations corroborate but do not establish the all-parameter proof. Earlier graded-graph and equal-norm point-set principles cover parts of the argument; scientific originality concerns only the explicit mixed-length solution and contact screening. Independent novelty evaluation remains outstanding.
title: Parallel-path screening and the exact minimum sphere of directed edge polytopes
